pkg.editor.title: Skin Package Properties
pkg.editor.partsHint:
Same from = same position. You can pick textures from other skin packages of the same vehicle to fill missing parts; parts set to 'Not Set' are not output (game uses default texture).
Candidates also include textures from other vehicles with the same from (marked 'Cross-Vehicle') — Gaijin reuses textures across different vehicles using the same from.
Tags on the right side of part names are guessed based on naming conventions (body part and texture type), for reference only (naming is not uniform).
pkg.editor.mode.notice:
You are modifying the write mode of a part (determines whether the blk writes replace_tex or set_tex). Please confirm your understanding:

• replace_tex: Replaces the original texture of this part with the new one — used by most parts.
• set_tex: Sets a camo skin texture; also writes param:t="camo_skin_tex", generally used only for the main camouflage texture of hull/airframe.

Writing incorrectly won't cause game errors, but the skin may not work or may behave abnormally.

Choosing '{0}' = apply this change and never prompt again; choosing '{1}' = make no changes this time, and will still prompt next time.
